SAINT PAUL, Minn.


, Oct. 6, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- 3M (NYSE: MMM) today announced the following investor event:


- **Third-quarter 2026 earnings conference call** on Tuesday, Oct. 20, 2026, at 8 a.m. CT.


This event will be webcast live and a replay will be available on 3M's Investor Relations website at[http://investors.3M.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789189-1&h=3121052050&u=https%3A%2F%2Fcts.businesswire.com%2Fct%2FCT%3Fid%3Dsmartlink%26url%3Dhttp%253A%252F%252Finvestors.3M.com%26esheet%3D52135902%26newsitemid%3D20191126005655%26lan%3Den-US%26anchor%3Dhttp%253A%252F%252Finvestors.3M.com%26index%3D1%26md5%3D5f9c693c7886178ba6e7d4414e6d1f96&a=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.3M.com) .


**About 3M**
3M (NYSE: MMM) is focused on transforming industries around the world by applying science and creating innovative, customer-focused solutions. Our multi-disciplinary team is working to solve tough customer problems by leveraging diverse technology platforms, differentiated capabilities, global footprint, and operational excellence.
